turns.assessment: The simultaneous flatlining of input power, output power, and pump current on oms.S15-S04.amp0, despite variation elsewhere, is characteristic of stale or frozen telemetry rather than an optical amplifier fault. The downstream S04 channel monitor, all later amplifiers, and line receivers show no change; therefore gain loss, pump failure, tilt, or noise-figure degradation are not supported. No documented fault mode in the case describes a monitoring/telemetry freeze, so the physical cause cannot be committed from the allowed modes.

score.why: cause flagged as unconsidered and absent
